description: Expander for MIX 4 STEREO and VCA MIX 4 STEREO, panning each of the four mix channels left and right; it goes to the right of the mix module, in the chain of expanders there

params.text: Pans that numbered channel: hard left at full counterclockwise, centre at noon, hard right at full clockwise
Scales and inverts that channel's pan CV before it is added to the pan knob, from -1 to 1; at its centre default the CV has no effect

inputs.text: Panning CV for that channel, added to its pan knob through the attenuverter, with -5V for hard left and 5V for hard right; polyphonic cables are supported

notes: the mono MIX 4 and VCA MIX 4 have no stereo outputs, so this expander only works with the stereo mix modules, one per module
the indicator lamp glows yellow once the expander has connected to a mix module
menu: Mono input pan law, on the mix module's menu — 0 dB (linear) through +/-1.5, 3, 4.5 and 6 dB, taken at the side or at the centre; +3 dB side is equal power
Stereo input pan law, on the mix module's menu — the same nine choices plus True panning (transfer content), which moves content from one side into the other, and Follow mono law
